verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a VS Code extension with @-mentions, plan review and conversation history directly in the editor, and a JetBrains plugin with selection context sharing and interactive diffs. The GitHub README also confirms use 'in your terminal, IDE'. Together these cover in-IDE chat with contextual help. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the IDE chat experience, and in-depth docs describing how the in-editor chat panel and its context handling work (the evidence is short overview blurbs only).
